entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Ravnica's premier detective with the Agency of Magicological Investigations who solved the Murders at Karlov Manor; formerly an Azorius lawmage.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Suspect in Zegana's murder whom Proft frees and later takes on as his aide.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Murder victim at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Murdered; her funeral is arranged at Karlov Cathedral.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: Scientist friend of Proft working for Niv-Mizzet, fatally stabbed at Krenko's safehouse.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Goblin criminal who abducted Kylox.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Assassin hired by Judith to kill Proft.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: Hired Massacre Girl to kill Proft.

entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: Golgari figure who analyzed the powder.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who entered Proft's mind palace to learn about his ability and stole a file.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who gave Proft the final clues and was his bait for the trap.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Attacked with Kaya by thugs.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Target of an attempted killing.

entities.name: Tolsimir Wolfblood
entities.description: Selesnya figure who falsely confessed to the murders.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave, revealed as the true killer.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of the trio of Trostani who attacked everyone present.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon who ran the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who worked with Proft to open an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: Reassured Kaito and contributed her abilities.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Demon of Duskmourn who later spies on Proft.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Rescued from Duskmourn.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Ravnican guild of the killer.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild Proft once belonged to.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Detective agency Proft joined after the Invasion.

entities.name: Murders at Karlov Manor
entities.description: Series of murders solved by Proft.

entities.name: Omenpath Project
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's project to control Omenpaths and make Ravnica a central power.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Proft's home plane.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: Plane of the House.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Selesnya's tree-city where Proft stages the reveal.

events.summary: Proft exposes and captures Etrata for Zegana's murder, then helps her escape custody.
events.quote: Three days later, believing Etrata was not guilty of the murder but may have information, he helped her escape from Azorius custody.

events.summary: Massacre Girl attacks Proft and Etrata and injures him before Etrata forces her to stand down.
events.quote: they were attacked by Massacre Girl , who had been hired by Judith to kill Proft

events.summary: Kylox is abducted by goblins and stabbed at Krenko's safehouse.
events.quote: a citizen burst into the window, bound for Krenko and fatally stabbed Kylox.

events.summary: Jace pulls Proft into his mind palace and steals a file.
events.quote: He stole one of the files containing Proft's knowledge and returned him to the physical world

events.summary: Kaya gives Proft three clues and he declares he knows the killer.
events.quote: These were the final clues Proft needed, and he declared that he knew the true killer's identity.

events.summary: Proft sets a trap using Kaya as bait and reveals the mind-control flower.
events.quote: As it was about to expel a burst of pollen, Kaya cut the stem, and Proft contained the flower in an Agency evidence capsule

events.summary: Proft deduces the killer is in the Selesnya Conclave and exposes Trostani; Tolsimir's false confession is rebuffed.
events.quote: However, Proft rebuffed him, asserting that he was trying to take the fall for the true killer: Trostani, guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave.

events.summary: Oba attacks; Etrata helps trap her in an Agency barrier ward and is neutralized by Oba's sisters.
events.quote: she ultimately helped trap Oba in an Agency barrier ward.

events.summary: Proft takes Etrata under his wing as his aide.
events.quote: In the aftermath of the fight, Proft took Etrata under his wing as his aide permanently

events.summary: Proft cracks Kylox's cryptex, learns of the Omenpath Project, and offers consulting to Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: Proft told the dragon that he knew about the project but would be willing to lend his skills to it for a consulting fee.

events.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn and rescues the party from Valgavoth.
events.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn by using his mind magic in combination with Kaito’s spark, Aminatou’s abilities, and a piece of wood from the House that Kaito had provided.

events.summary: Proft, Etrata and Niv-Mizzet finish securing Ravnica's Omenpaths; Valgavoth begins spying on Proft.
events.quote: Valgavoth was able to begin spying on him using the House's doors.

relations.quote: He is the master detective who solved the Murders at Karlov Manor .
